observations.content: User supplied context-only preparation packets 1–9/12 containing historical requirements and repository excerpts for the observational-memory project; packets are reference data for a later explicit implementation prompt, and no implementation was requested during those turns.

Historical task requirements: expose actual pi usage cost of every observer and consolidator worker run to the parent orchestrator, including ephemeral or unsuccessful runs when valid usage exists; persist valid costs in session-ledger entries with role/run identity; include all branch costs, including abandoned branches, in session totals; ignore missing, malformed, non-finite, or negative values; surface totals in status/footer UI; add focused tests for aggregation, invalid entries, handoff, and display.

The observational-memory implementation plan specifies phased delivery: Phase A short-term observer, branch-local ledger, deterministic compaction, and TUI; Phase B consolidator and durable .memory files. Workers launch as ordinary recorded global pi subprocess sessions using bespoke child_process.spawn and a shared worker extension parameterized by OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator; OM modules are vendored and trimmed; a per-session /om gate defaults off and must make the extension inert while disabled.

Observer chunks are fixed-token source slices dispatched in parallel with default concurrency 4; the worker's recorded -p prompt contains the fenced inert chunk. Observer results are validated and committed to the master ledger as om.observations.recorded with coversUpToId; orchestrator assigns unique second-resolution timestamp IDs and computes tokenCount. Ledger folding and watermarks support /tree rollback.

Compaction deterministically projects observations before a chunk-boundary cutoff, renders journey then memory map then observations, and preserves the verbatim tail without double representation. It waits for relevant in-flight observers but can skip safely when observers cannot affect projection. Mid-run compaction may resume via hidden om.resume message; terminal turns do not resume.

Phase B consolidator promotes oldest observations above poolTargetTokens when the active pool reaches consolidateAtPoolTokens, runs one at a time in the background, edits only .memory-scoped topic files and JOURNEY.md, and on clean exit tombstones the handed batch intersected with still-active observations; INDEX.md is orchestrator-generated. .memory files and journey are durable across /tree.

README and supplied code describe an implemented observational-memory extension with default-off /om gate, /om:status, /om:compact, /om:consolidate commands, footer gauges, worker widgets/toasts, a status timeline, project .memory topic files, and descriptive JOURNEY.md; documented/default config values conflict in places, including chunkTokens 5000 versus 10000 and consolidation threshold 20000 versus 15000.

Supplied tests cover timestamp assignment, ledger fold/progress/projection, compaction cutoff and observer-wait fast path, pool promotion, memory path rendering, worker IPC/tools, status gauges, timeline rendering, and rendering order. The excerpts include potential inconsistencies between plan/README and code; they are historical reference, not confirmation that tests were run.
